parameters.name: ConfigKey
parameters.description: The name of the configuration item that you want to query. For more information, see the **ConfigKey** parameter in [ModifyDefenseSceneConfig](~~2968435~~).

parameters.name: DefenseScene
parameters.description: The defense scenario whose configuration you want to query. For more information, see the **DefenseScene** parameter in [ModifyDefenseSceneConfig](~~2968435~~).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of your WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
